name: serpapi_hotel_search
description: Search hotel options through SerpApi Google Hotels with normalized hotel fields like nightly price, total price, rating, class, and amenities.

destination.description: Destination or city name. Used when query is omitted.

query.description: Full Google Hotels query. If omitted, destination is used.

check_in_date.description: Required check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

check_out_date.description: Required check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

children_ages.description: Optional child ages. Count should match children.

currency.description: Currency code for price fields (default: USD).

hl.description: Language code for Google Hotels results (default: en).

gl.description: Country code for Google Hotels results (default: us).

sort_by.description: Optional sort mode. Examples: 3 lowest price, 8 highest rating, 13 most reviewed.

rating.description: Optional Google Hotels rating filter. Examples: 7 for 3.5+, 8 for 4.0+, 9 for 4.5+.

hotel_class.description: Optional hotel class filter. Single value or comma-separated values like 3 or 3,4,5.

free_cancellation.description: If true, filter to properties with free cancellation.

device.description: desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.

num_results.description: How many normalized hotel results to return (1-10, default: 5).

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

extra_params.description: Additional engine-specific query parameters passed through to SerpApi.

include_raw.description: If true, include full raw SerpApi payload in data.raw.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
